title: Endcap site selection and collateral routing for DevCon West
text:
Endcap site selection and collateral routing for DevCon West

['From: Sam Torres <sam.torres@devcon.ai>\\nTo: mina_haddad@redwood.example.com\\nCc: ops@devcon.ai\\nDate: Fri, 01 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700\\nSubject: Booth location options — endcap vs. corner near Entrance B\\n\\nHi Mina,\\n\\nAttached are the floorplan options for DevCon West. Two viable endcap slots opened up in East Hall: E12 (endcap next to Demo Alley) and C1 (corner near Entrance B).\\n\\nHigh level differences:\\n- E12 (Endcap, 10ft x 20ft): much higher traffic from Demo Alley, sightlines are great but power run is ~12m from nearest floorbox.\\n- C1 (Corner, 10ft x 20ft): lower immediate demo traffic but closer to registration and lounges; power run is shorter and loading is easier.\\n\\nI attached a PDF with annotated sightline photos and the standard expo power quote. If you have a preference we can reserve the slot for 48 hours.\\n\\nAttachments: DevCon_floorplan_options.pdf\\n\\nThanks,\\nSam\\nSam Torres\\nExhibitor Relations — DevCon\\nsam.torres@devcon.ai\\n(415) 555-0198\\n', "From: mina_haddad@redwood.example.com\\nTo: marissa_cole@redwood.example.com, naomi_feldman@redwood.example.com, logan_wright@redwood.example.com\\nCc: sam.torres@devcon.ai\\nDate: Fri, 01 Jun 2028 10:03:22 -0700\\nSubject: Re: Booth location options — endcap vs. corner near Entrance B\\n\\nThanks Sam — got the floorplans. Internal thoughts below.\\n\\nQuick summary: we lean toward E12 (Demo Alley endcap) for visibility, but need to confirm power, freight timing, and a lightweight signage package to preserve sightlines.\\n\\nActions I need from the group:\\n- Logan: confirm we can run a 30ft power whip from the provided floorbox (see spec in redwood_booth_specs_v3.pdf). If vendor cost is >$1,200 we'll consider C1.\\n- Naomi: do we have enough marketing collateral to sustain high throughput (500–700 handouts/day)? See collateral_manifest.xlsx attached for counts.\\n- Marissa: can you sign off on the incremental power + signage spend (estimate in attachments) so I can lock E12 within 48 hours?\\n\\nAlso Sam — can you confirm whether E12 has an AV riser option and whether the freight door for E hall is accessible for 10x20 crates on Monday morning (preferred move-in)?\\n\\nAttachments: redwood_booth_specs_v3.pdf, collateral_manifest.xlsx\\n\\n—Mina\\nMina Haddad\\nField Marketing Manager | Redwood Inference\\nmina.haddad@redwood.example.com\\n", 'From: naomi_feldman@redwood.example.com\\nTo: mina_haddad@redwood.example.com, marissa_cole@redwood.example.com\\nCc: logan_wright@redwood.example.com, sam.torres@devcon.ai\\nDate: Fri, 01 Jun 2028 11:28:45 -0700\\nSubject: Re: Booth location options — collateral & signage needs\\n\\nMina — thanks. I reviewed the manifest. Short notes:\\n\\n- Collateral: current printed inventory = 2,000 one-pagers, 1,200 pocket guides, 300 demo cards. For an endcap with sustained traffic I recommend ordering an additional 1,000 pocket guides and 500 demo cards.\\n- Giveaways: we planned 1,500 enamel pins; recommend bump to 2,000 (higher throughput).\\n- Signage: prefer a single tall backwall graphic + two hanging blades instead of multiple small posters to keep sightlines clean. I attached quick mockups (signage-mockups.png).\\n- Shipping: suggest using expo courier for day-before delivery to avoid storage fees; costs in the manifest.\\n\\nIf Marissa signs off on the delta cost (estimated $3,200), we can release PO for print and pins tomorrow.\\n\\n-naomi\\nNaomi Feldman\\nSr. Field Marketing Specialist\\n', "From: marissa_cole@redwood.example.com\\nTo: mina_haddad@redwood.example.com, naomi_feldman@redwood.example.com, logan_wright@redwood.example.com\\nCc: sam.torres@devcon.ai\\nDate: Mon, 04 Jun 2028 09:02:10 -0700\\nSubject: Re: Booth location options — approval to reserve E12 (conditional)\\n\\nTeam — conditional approval to reserve E12. Conditions to finalize:\\n1) Logan confirms power whip and final vendor quote <= $1,500.\\n2) Naomi finalizes print order and confirms lead time (must be in-hand by June 20).\\n3) Mina confirms we have a logistics fallback (C1) if freight window for E hall is blocked.\\n\\nIf all three true I'll approve the $3,200 delta from events budget allocation EVT-2028-Q2. Mina, please proceed to reserve E12 for 48 hours and escalate if vendor timing/budget is off.\\n\\n-Marissa\\nMarissa Cole\\nSr. Director, Field Marketing | Redwood Inference\\nmarissa.cole@redwood.example.com\\n", 'From: DevCon Ops <ops@devcon.ai>\\nTo: mina_haddad@redwood.example.com, marissa_cole@redwood.example.com, naomi_feldman@redwood.example.com, logan_wright@redwood.example.com\\nDate: Wed, 07 Jun 2028 16:45:00 -0700\\nSubject: Re: Booth location options — confirmation and move-in windows\\n\\nHi Mina/Marissa/Team,\\n\\nGood news — E12 has been held for Redwood pending deposit. Details below:\\n- Location: East Hall, Endcap E12 (10x20).\\n- Move-in window: Monday, Jun 26 07:00–11:00 (heavy freight morning).\\n- Power: floorbox available ~12m from booth edge. Atlas can run whip for $1,100 (quote attached).\\n- AV riser: available as a rental at additional $420.\\n- Loading dock: East Hall dock is scheduled 06/26 06:00–12:00 — crate deliveries accepted.\\n\\nPlease confirm by sending the deposit link to bookings@devcon.ai within 24 hours to lock space. Attached: DevCon_floorplan_options.pdf (annotated) and Atlas quote.\\n\\nThanks,\\nDevCon Ops\\n\\n----- Forwarded message -----\\nFrom: Atlas Expo Logistics <logistics@atlas-expo.com>\\nDate: Wed, 07 Jun 2028 15:50:00 -0700\\nSubject: Re: power whip quote for E12\\n\\nAtlas: We can do the whip + rigging for $1,100 and deliver Monday morning. ETA for installation during move-in is ~90 minutes.\\n\\nAttachments: atlas_power_quote.pdf\\n']
